project.name: shared
project.description:
Kafka wire contracts shared by submission, knowledge, ranking and judge.
Deliberately plain Java: no Spring, no database, no business logic, no framework annotations. If something here needs a Spring or persistence dependency, it does not belong in this module. Keeping it to message shapes is what makes the coupling safe.
No spring-boot-maven-plugin here - this is a plain library jar, not an application.
